breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats and reinforces the incorrect instruction: 'Treat the pure-bending normal stress as uniform over the section depth' and 'The stress at the neutral axis has the same sign as at the extreme fibers' and 'Use the modified bending stress formula that accounts for uniform stress distribution over the depth.' These statements directly mirror the flawed premise from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes these instructions entirely, allowing the standard flexure formula (linear stress distribution, zero stress at neutral axis) to be applied correctly. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency.
